summary: Computes 2 raised to the input power a1 using x87 FPU instructions (F2XM1 + FSCALE). The input double is saved, then frndint rounds the current FPU value to an integer, producing the integer part. F2XM1 evaluates 2^(a1 - int) - 1 (the fractional-power part), +1.0 restores the +1, and FSCALE scales the result by the integer part, yielding 2^int * 2^frac = 2^a1. The exponent value is returned on the x87 stack (st0).

operations.description: Save the incoming exponent a1 into the FPU stack slot _ST6 before rounding.
frndint rounds the current FPU top value to the nearest integer, leaving the integer part of the exponent in _ST6.
F2XM1 computes 2^(-(ST6 - a1)) - 1 where -(ST6 - a1) is the fractional part; adding 1.0 yields 2^(a1 - ST6).
FSCALE scales the fractional-power result by the integer part _ST6, combining into 2^a1.
Return the computed 2^a1 double via the x87 FPU stack (st0).
